title: CLR/5/2010 of SMT. ANITA RANI MITTAL Vs SMT. MADHU AND ORS

paras.text:
MCC No. 977 of 2017
CLMA No. 12659 of 2017
In
CLR No. 5 of 2010
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. K.N. Joshi, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. Mohd. Umar, Advocate for the
respondents.
Heard.
Recall application (MCC No. 977 of
2017) has been filed by the respondents
for recall of the order dated 21.07.2017
along with delay condonation application
(CLMA No. 12659 of 2017).
No grounds has been mentioned in
the delay condonation application as to
why application has not been filed within
time as well no sufficient reason has
been shown as to why earlier counsel,
engaged by the respondents did not
appear before this Court to argue the
matter. General allegation has been
made by the respondents against the
previous counsel in her affidavit but
what action has been taken against the
counsel has not been mentioned.
The writ petition was decided by
this Court on the basis of material
available on the record.
No sufficient reasons have been
assigned to recall the order dated
21.07.2017. Once the order was passed
on merit, the recall application is not
maintainable.
Delay condonation and recall
applications are hereby dismissed.
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
Parul 07.11.2017
